column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PRIMARY COURT’S PROCEDURE
ACT, NO. OF 1979
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-
1. This Act may be cited as the Primary Court’s Procedure
(Amendment) Act, No.     of 2024.
